Hon'ble Mr. Justice Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi Order On Board Neutral Citation
2024:Cghc:9433 14-03-2024
1.

Since both the bail applications arise out of a common crime number and registered at same
police station, therefore, they are being heard analogously and decided by this Common order.

2. The applicants have filed these applications for grant of anticipatory bail as they are
apprehending their arrest in connection with Crime No.273/2023 registered at police station
Punjipathra, District - Raigarh (C.G.) for the offence punishable under Section 420 read with
Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that applicants of both the cases were working on the post of
Chemist in Sunil Ispat & Power Pvt. Limited , Chiraipani, District Raigarh.

It is alleged that they
used to give false grading report with regard to maganise Ore and Ferro slag, which aforesaid
Company purchased from New Era Trading Company, Nagpur & R.R. Enerprises, Raipur.

It is also
alleged that applicants used to prepare such false report in connivance with the employees of
aforesaid Companies and Transport and thereby they cheated the complainant.

4. Learned counsel appearing for the applicants would submit that although applicants were
working as Chemist in the Sunil Ispat & Power Pvt. Limited , but the date, on which, alleged false
grading report was said to be prepared, they were absent from their duties, which is evident from
muster roll of October, 2023.

It is further submitted that actually as per aforesaid muster roll
(Annexure P-3), applicants were absent in whole month of October, 2023, as "A " {absent} has been
marked to them for each Neutral Citation 2024:Cghc:9433 date.

It is next submitted that
applicants have been used as scapegoat by respondent No. 2 - Company.

It is further submitted that
this is first crime registered against them and, therefore, they may be extended the benefit of Section
438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State, who is assisted by counsel for the
Objector/complainant while opposing the submissions made by counsel for the applicants would
submit that it was the duty of the applicants to submit report with regard to maganise Ore and Ferro
slag, which was received to the Sunil Ispat & Power Pvt. Limited from New Era Trading Company,
Nagpur & R.R. Enterprises, Raipur, but they in collusion with those companies and some
transporters used to give false report of higher grading but when on the date of incident, it was
cross-checked, then those items were found of low grading and thereby they caused loss to the
factory to the tune of Rs. 26,27,111/-

sentences.text:
I have heard learned counsel appearing for the parties and perused the case diary and other
material available on record.

7. Allegations against the applicants are that they reported alleged materials of higher grade, but
when it was re-checked, then it was found low grade, on this count present Fir has been lodged by
Manager of Sunil Ispat & Power Pvt. Limited, but no test report, which must be two in number, has
been enclosed with the Fir to demonstrate that earlier higher grading was reported and
subsequently, when the material was re-checked, then it was found low graded.

Further, as per
muster roll, 2

023 filed by the Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:9433 applicants, they have been shown absent in entire month of October, 2023, hence, considering the totality of the facts, I am of the view that it is a fit case to grant anticipatory bail to the applicants.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicants shall be released on anticipatory bail on each of them furnishing a bond in the sum of  25,000/- with one sureties for the like sum to the satisfaction of the officer/Court arresting them and they shall abide by all the following terms and conditions:
(i) that the accused/applicants shall cooperate with the investigation and make themselves available for interrogation before the concerned Investigating Officer as and when required.
(ii) that the accused/applicants shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
(iii) that the accused/applicants shall not act, in any manner, which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial; and (iv) that the applicants shall appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to them by the said Court till disposal of the trial.
Certified copy, as per rules.

Sd/-
(Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi) Judge Amit/-
